source_refs.note: Topic 2.6.1.1 (PDF 50-51, printed 47-48). The printed list omits a comma ('"Apple" "Banana"'); recorded.

blocks.text: A list is created by placing items inside square brackets [ ], separated by commas. Lists can contain items of different types, such as numbers, strings, or even other lists.
Example: Create a list of your favorite fruits.

blocks.title: Book correction
blocks.text: The list is printed without a comma between "Apple" and "Banana". Python then joins the two strings, and the program prints ['Mango', 'AppleBanana']. With the comma, fruits = ["Mango", "Apple", "Banana"] prints ['Mango', 'Apple', 'Banana'].
Explanation: This code creates a list named 'fruits' containing three elements and then prints the list.
